substrate.physical_state: soluble aliphatic diamine and dicarboxylic-acid-derived building blocks, including growing oligomers
substrate.access_constraint: candidate must be assessed for repeated chain extension rather than only a single terminal ligation

enzyme_requirements.activation: use or plausibly accommodate an activated carboxyl partner
enzyme_requirements.assembly: assess whether the catalytic architecture can support repeated oligomer extension

review_requirements: Assess reaction direction and the activating chemistry.
Assess compatibility with amine-bearing and dicarboxylate-like substrate features.
Assess whether the observed native context supports repeated extension or only one-off ligation.
